title: Ad-Duha 93:1-4 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Ash-Sharh, Ad-Duha 1 to 8 and applying the rules
source: Written for quran/y3 lesson 36 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ad-Duha 93:1-4 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 36. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَٱلضُّحَىٰ (١) وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ (٢) مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ (٣) وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ (٤)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].

head: Word
Where
Rule
How to read it
rows: Sun letter: laam is silent, ض has shaddah
Idgham without ghunnah: tanween into ل

questions.q: Chunk and link Ad-Duha 93:1-4 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 93:1-4 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 93:1-4 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: What is better than this world, according to 93:4?
Why is there no ghunnah in «خَيْرٌۭ لَّكَ»?
questions.a: Idgham into ل and ر has no ghunnah.

questions.q: 93:3 tells the Prophet ﷺ that his Lord has ...
questions.a: A) not left him. 93:3: 'Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].'

questions.q: Ad-Duha 93:3: «مَا وَدَّعَكَ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Has someone ever forgotten about you? Allah told the Prophet ﷺ that He had not left him. How would that feel?
questions.a: Comforting and safe: Allah never forgets or abandons those who turn to Him.
